summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed with no stubs. Running eval/compare_q.py on real data with a spec lacking out_logits raised ZeroDivisionError at eval/compare_q.py:185 at e1d2fa11d657 and at the fix parent d860f8e1e106. At the fix c0a2028fb579 the command exited 0 and reported perplexity 19.362825. This supersedes the stubbed attempt 001.
what_ran: repro.py runs the unmodified eval/compare_q.py command with -d and -m on GPU 1: 2 rows of 256 tokens from wikitext-2-raw-v1 test split (Hub dataset wikitext at b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3), tokenized by transformers, evaluated by unquantized Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct through the exllamav3 loader.
limits: Two rows only, so the perplexity is not a benchmark figure. One unquantized model. The ledger's secondary point about collect_logits was not observed separately, because the division fails first. Third-party packages are real, resolved as of 2025-06-01 (transformers 4.52.4, datasets 3.6.0, gptqmodel 2.2.0, aqlm 1.1.7, autoawq 0.2.9, vptq 0.0.5.post1, bitsandbytes 0.46.0, exllamav2 0.3.1, llama-cpp-python 0.3.9); logbar, tokenicer and device_smi were added because gptqmodel imports them.
